description.value: Mid Island Liquor is part of Mid Island Co-op, a locally-owned co-operative with 18 locations serving communities across Vancouver Island and the Gulf Islands. This Nanaimo location on Haliburton Street offers a retail selection of beer, wine, and spirits from a co-operative that emphasizes local products and community involvement. Touring cyclists will find it a convenient stop for resupply in central Nanaimo.
